title: held --overlaps, claim and the plan's overlap warnings compare touches by repository and glob
goal: with a repositories map an item's touches are <repo>/<glob> (workspace/<glob> for workspace files): bl_base.touches_overlap, held --overlaps, claim's refusal of a held path and the plan's unordered-overlap warning compare two items' touches only within one repository, and a project with no map compares them as before

gates.question: With a repositories map declared, how are two touches compared when one names neither a declared repository nor workspace as its first segment?
options: compared whole as written, like a project with no map (a wildcard first segment still meets every repository)
never overlaps a touch of another repository, as if it had a repository of its own
gates.recommendation: compared whole as written, like a project with no map (a wildcard first segment still meets every repository)

gates.question: claim compares no touches today (held --overlaps before the claim is the held-path guard, kb-sprint run step 2): does this item add a held-path refusal to claim itself?
options: no: held --overlaps, compared by repository and glob, stays the one pre-claim guard and claim is unchanged
yes: claim refuses an item whose touches meet a held one in the same repository
gates.recommendation: no: held --overlaps, compared by repository and glob, stays the one pre-claim guard and claim is unchanged
